page.title: Audit & Evaluation
page.lede: Measured evidence from the evaluation artefacts, together with its limitations. This page only reads: there is no threshold tuning and no live experiment.
page.baselinesBody: Four approaches on the same test split. The statistical layer is only worth keeping if it delivers a measurable gain over rules alone.
page.perModeBody: The hybrid approach's numbers for all four modes. A mode with no examples in the test split is marked not measured, not zero.
page.perModeCaption: Precision, recall, and F1 per risk mode
page.falsePositiveSubtitle: The lower it is, the less review effort is wasted
page.precisionSubtitle: The share of reviewed cases that genuinely carry an injected pattern

placeholder.noRunTitle: No evaluation has been run yet
placeholder.noRunBody: This page only shows artefacts that have already been produced. An evaluation is run offline by an engineer against the frozen test split — not from this page, and not from a button.
placeholder.failedTitle: The evaluation results could not be loaded
placeholder.failedBody: The service did not answer. This is different from “no evaluation yet”: the artefacts may exist, but could not be read from here.

latency.heading: Processing time
latency.body: The time to screen one claim file on a development machine. Not a production figure, and it says nothing about national-scale load. Values are rounded to whole milliseconds, so p50 and p95 can look identical on a very fast screening; the full figures are in this run's <1>{{file}}</1>.

synthetic.body: Every number on this page comes from synthetic data generated by this project. These figures are <1>not</1> estimates of prevalence, cost, or the behaviour of any real facility.

version.heading: Version stamp
version.thresholds: Band thresholds are set from quantiles of the score distribution on the validation split alone — never on the train or test split. The technical formulation is recorded in this run's <1>{{file}}</1>.
